why: Intro to the terminal, 'Read files with cat, less and head' (passes: wc -l prints 3 for each of the three notes). wc -l prints 3 for day1.txt and day2.txt but 2 for summit.txt (one of its lines was written with > and overwrote). A 3 next to some .txt is on screen; not every note has three lines.

step.title: Count the lines
step.instructions: In trail-log, run wc -l on the three notes (day1.txt, day2.txt and summit.txt) and check each one has 3 lines.

targets.caption: Count the lines in each note

files.trail-log/notes/day1.txt:
Sunny, 18C
Trail dry
Saw a deer
files.trail-log/notes/day2.txt:
Light rain
Muddy trail
Camp by the lake
files.trail-log/notes/summit.txt:
Reached the summit
Clouds below us

Terminal: tripi@mac trail-log % wc -l notes/day1.txt notes/day2.txt notes/summit.txt
